questions: How many samples, islands and vortices did you measure? The abstract says "MZMs are observed in all measured vortices"; could you give the number of vortices behind "all"?
If some regions or vortices were set aside (for example regions with defects, given your choice of "a defect-free region"), how many, and why?

Which fields, temperatures and setpoints did you measure beyond the ones shown? In particular, what fields were used in Fig. 4B-D, and do you have vortex-core spectra at fields other than 1.0 T or at temperatures above 0.4 K?
What does the second-best vortex look like? A full line cut and level fit for another vortex, ideally one from the two- and three-vortex islands of Fig. 4, would help.

Your Fig. 3G energies give level ratios E2/E1 of about 2.5 (positive bias, 1.96/0.79) and 2.3 (negative bias, 2.1/0.93), and spacings of 0.79 to 1.17 meV, while the text gives "an energy spacing of about 0.7 meV". Could you plot EL/ΔE against integer and half-odd-integer lines, per vortex, and say which spacing is intended?

For the Bi2Te3 branch, the text gives a level spacing of "~0.03 µeV". With Δ of 1.85 to 2.92 meV and EF of about 300 meV, Δ²/EF comes to roughly 11 to 28 µeV (about 0.01 to 0.03 meV). Which value and which Δ did you intend?
Did you vary the tip-sample distance (setpoint conductance) at the vortex center, and does the zero-bias peak height behave differently from the finite-energy CdGM peaks?
Could you show spectra at the same vortex-core location at 0 T and 1.0 T, and the topography there, to exclude a magnetic impurity such as interstitial Fe, and the peak's temperature dependence?
